raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batches 12-14 switched from status 'POSTED' to 'SETTLED' in the card feed (per the 2026-01-16 payments-source note, meaning unchanged), but silver_transactions still filters on status = 'POSTED', so those rows are silently dropped. Widening the filter to include 'SETTLED' restores the intended population, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
